lines.2: 「Otome's here. Perfect timing. Will you tell us your answer?」
lines.3: 「Hah! I knew my answer from the very beginning!」
lines.4: Fukahire smoothly moved over to the Princess's side.
lines.5: 「(A student council full of women this beautiful is unheard of. I'm definitely joining. The rest of you can stay out.)」
lines.6: 「I hate that I can pretty much tell what Fukahire's thinking.」
lines.8: 「I'll do it too! I like the terms!」
lines.9: The snacks and naps had reeled her in.
lines.11: 「Well, I don't know how much help I'll be, but I guess I'll give it a try too.」
lines.15: 「That leaves only Tsushima. So, what is your move?」
lines.16: It would be dangerous to surrender to the excitement of the moment here.
lines.18: I was only thinking before I acted.
lines.19: 「You really are indecisive. This is tiresome. May I simply order you to join?」
lines.21: Damn. I was being mocked by someone who could not even write the word 'indecisive' in kanji.
lines.22: I could work alongside Erika Kiriya.
